content: CRF involves two parts for prediction. First we should compute the scores for each label based $\mathbf {h}_t^{\text{ner}}$ , resulting in $\mathbf {o}_t^{\text{ner}}$ , whose dimension is the number of output labels. The other part is a transition matrix $\mathbf {T}$ which defines the scores of two successive labels. $\mathbf {T}$ is also a model parameter. Based on $\mathbf {o}_t^{\text{ner}}$ and $\mathbf {T}$ , we use the Viterbi algorithm to find the best-scoring label sequence.
